title: Quick Steamed Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A light and aerated Vietnamese dish featuring chilli powder and steamed tofu noodles, made in a kadhai and suitable for Jain-friendly diets. This winey flavored dish is perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Fill a kadhai with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil.
Add the rice noodles to the kadhai and steam for 5 minutes.
While the noodles are steaming, cut the tofu into small cubes.
In a small bowl, mix together the chilli powder, soy sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger.
Add the tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the chilli powder mixture.
Once the noodles are done, remove them from the kadhai and set aside.
Add the tofu to the kadhai and steam for an additional 2 minutes.
To serve, place the steamed noodles in a bowl and top with the steamed tofu and chopped green onions.
